title: Elizondo met Edward Teller on an Air Florida flight
place_text: Air Florida flight, Sarasota to Miami

tellings.quote: when I was a kid I was about seven years old on a air Florida uh flight my father uh had some friends in the government and he uh put me on a plane with him

plain: When he was about seven, Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official later known for his work on UFOs, says he was put on an Air Florida flight from Sarasota to Miami and ended up travelling with Edward Teller, the physicist known as the father of the hydrogen bomb. Elizondo tells it as his own memory, explaining that his father had friends in the government and placed him on the plane with Teller. He tells it as an early brush with the world of top-level weapons science he would later work near.
